mapper.insert: insert into report_execution_report ( id, project_id, execution_run_id, request_key, status, schema_version, source_run_digest, report_summary_json, redaction_policy_json, generated_by, generated_at, failed_code, failure_summary, trace_id, archived_at, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{projectId}, #{executionRunId}, #{requestKey}, #{status}, #{schemaVersion}, #{sourceRunDigest}, cast(coalesce(#{reportSummaryJson}, '{}') as jsonb), cast(coalesce(#{redactionPolicyJson}, '{}') as jsonb), #{generatedBy}, #{generatedAt}, #{failedCode}, #{failureSummary}, #{traceId}, #{archivedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) on conflict do nothing
mapper.update: update report_execution_report set status = #{status}, schema_version = #{schemaVersion}, source_run_digest = #{sourceRunDigest}, report_summary_json = cast(coalesce(#{reportSummaryJson}, '{}') as jsonb), redaction_policy_json = cast(coalesce(#{redactionPolicyJson}, '{}') as jsonb), generated_by = #{generatedBy}, generated_at = #{generatedAt}, failed_code = #{failedCode}, failure_summary = #{failureSummary}, trace_id = #{traceId}, archived_at = #{archivedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}

update report_execution_report set status = #{report.status}, schema_version = #{report.schemaVersion}, source_run_digest = #{report.sourceRunDigest}, report_summary_json = cast(coalesce(#{report.reportSummaryJson}, '{}') as jsonb), redaction_policy_json = cast(coalesce(#{report.redactionPolicyJson}, '{}') as jsonb), generated_by = #{report.generatedBy}, generated_at = #{report.generatedAt}, failed_code = #{report.failedCode}, failure_summary = #{report.failureSummary}, trace_id = #{report.traceId}, archived_at = #{report.archivedAt}, updated_at = #{report.updatedAt} where id = #{report.id} and status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.insert: insert into report_defect_draft ( id, report_id, diagnosis_id, status, title, reproduction_summary, impact_summary, priority_suggestion, evidence_refs_json, payload_preview_json, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{reportId}, #{diagnosisId}, #{status}, #{title}, #{reproductionSummary}, #{impactSummary}, #{prioritySuggestion}, cast(coalesce(#{evidenceRefsJson}, '[]') as jsonb), cast(coalesce(#{payloadPreviewJson}, '{}') as jsonb), #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update report_defect_draft set diagnosis_id = #{diagnosisId}, status = #{status}, title = #{title}, reproduction_summary = #{reproductionSummary}, impact_summary = #{impactSummary}, priority_suggestion = #{prioritySuggestion}, evidence_refs_json = cast(coalesce(#{evidenceRefsJson}, '[]') as jsonb), payload_preview_json = cast(coalesce(#{payloadPreviewJson}, '{}') as jsonb), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where report_id = #{reportId} and id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from report_execution_report where status = 'QUEUED' order by created_at asc, id asc limit #{limit}
select from report_evidence_manifest where report_id = #{reportId} order by created_at asc, source_wp asc, source_type asc, id asc
select from report_failure_diagnosis where report_id = #{reportId} order by updated_at desc, created_at desc, id desc limit 1
select from report_defect_draft where report_id = #{reportId} order by updated_at desc, created_at desc, id desc
